name: Cruz Missile
summary: The Playtest-1 car: a Holden Cruze-based rally sedan code-built from the owner's reference sheets (R81), rebuilt against its contact sheet in br-bwju.11: painted pillars and roof with black-framed side glass and a black B pillar; the sheet's lightning livery traced into the atlas (side, bonnet, roof, boot and wing bolts); big angular headlamps in dark brows wrapping onto the wings over a black hex-mesh grille with its round badge; the bent nudge bar with four cyan LED blocks, hex fog lamps, pink bumper wedges and a black splitter; the UHF whip with its coil and red tip; two-part tail lamps wrapping onto the quarters, a boot badge, a finned diffuser with a red reverse-light triangle, hex exhaust and pink L corners; 16-sided tyres on five-spoke rims. LOD0 2037 triangles (qualified budget now 3000). Front drive, 1200 kg (R136: the Cruze is front-driven). The physics hulls are frozen at the P1-V02 bake (the Cruz is in the feel bank).
feedback: Comment on this page (what to change, which view or state); the session turns each comment into a bug bead that cites this page and the car's id.

reference.note: Left to right per view: the reference, the model rendered from the same view, and the silhouette diff (green is model outside the reference, red is reference the model misses). Front IoU is limited by the reference's own perspective, so don't chase it.

damage.note: Left to right: intact; door_FL and door_RL loose; front and back loose; wheel_FL cambered; front, door_FL and wheel_FL detached; a stripped shell. Detached parts persist as dynamic debris, so the lying parts are the debris they leave.

paints.pattern: Seat colour on the paint key, the number on the roof (anchor roof_number) and in the HUD badge; tyres stay dark, glass and lamps keep their colour. Full-tier patterns (plan section 2.3) are not drawn yet.

the headlamps and wraps render as a flat white/cream patch (the sheet's lamps are warm, glowing and shaded)
